$comment: Catalog of prebuilt 3b1b-style animated scenes a storyboard step may embed via step.viz.scene. MUST stay in sync with the VIZ_SCENES registry in apps/bookshelf/src/viz/scenes.ts (the Node-side validator can't import TSX, so this JSON is its source of truth). Run `node generator/check-viz-catalog.mjs` after changing either side. Durations are the scene timelines' native seconds — in a book the scene is time-scaled onto the step's audio window, so they're advisory (pick steps whose narration runs long enough that the scene isn't comically fast).

scenes.title: Fourier Series
scenes.summary: Rotating arrows (epicycles) sum tip-to-tail into a square wave, its frequency spectrum, and finally a star drawn by 128 circles on circles.

scenes.title: Gradient Descent
scenes.summary: Loss as a contoured landscape: the gradient says which way is downhill, and a ball steps toward the valley — learning-rate too small, too big, just right.

scenes.title: Self-Attention
scenes.summary: Six token vectors each make a Query, Key and Value; dot-product scores turn into softmax weights and every word becomes a context-aware blend.

scenes.title: Diffusion Models
scenes.summary: A point-cloud image melts into noise step by step, then a learned score field walks it back — noising and denoising as two walks between data and noise.

scenes.title: Raft Consensus
scenes.summary: Five servers with nervous election timers pick a leader, replicate a log entry to a majority, survive a partition, and re-elect in a new term.

scenes.title: Backpropagation
scenes.summary: A tiny network computes forward, then gradients flow backward node by node — the chain rule stitching local slopes into weight updates.

scenes.title: Eigenvectors
scenes.summary: A matrix warps the plane's whole grid; most arrows change direction, but eigenvectors stay on their line and only scale by their eigenvalue.

scenes.title: Convolution
scenes.summary: A 3×3 kernel slides across an image grid, multiplying and summing at each stop — the same mechanism blurs, then finds edges.

scenes.title: Bayes' Theorem
scenes.summary: 2,000 people, a rare disease, a good test: counting who actually lights up turns Bayes' rule into a headcount — and a surprising 9% posterior.

scenes.title: Consistent Hashing
scenes.summary: hash(key) mod N reshuffles nearly every key when a server joins; bending the line into a ring keeps ownership stable in small arcs.

scenes.title: CRDTs
scenes.summary: Two devices bump a shared counter offline, then merge without a referee — per-device tallies (a G-Counter) make the sync conflict-free.

scenes.title: Central Limit Theorem
scenes.summary: One flat die knows nothing, but sums of many dice pile into a bell curve — the central limit theorem emerging live from raw rolls.

scenes.title: Bloom Filters
scenes.summary: Keys hash into a shared bit array through several hash functions — an instant 'definitely not' vs 'probably yes', and how false positives sneak in.

scenes.title: Differential Dataflow
scenes.summary: A dataflow of operators updates from (data, time, diff) deltas — a join's arrangement absorbs changes and retractions ripple through instead of recomputing.

scenes.title: Entropy & Information
scenes.summary: Surprise = log2(1/p) as a curve; a four-outcome forecast's average surprise becomes H = 1.75 bits, distributions morph to max out or collapse the meter, and prefix-free codewords hit the entropy floor.

scenes.title: The Kalman Filter
scenes.summary: A hallway robot with a noisy sensor: belief as a Gaussian that slides and spreads on predict, then multiplies against each measurement and snaps sharper — predict/correct on repeat until the estimate hugs the truth.

scenes.title: PageRank
scenes.summary: A five-page web: a random surfer's visit counts become power iteration, damping adds the 15% teleport, and the bars freeze into the stationary ranking.

scenes.title: Replay — Agents That Prove Their Work
scenes.summary: A worker agent's happy browser session is a claim, not evidence: an adversarial critic interrogates the Replay recording — three-layer charge check, diff coverage, mock hunt — then promotes surviving sessions into tests.

scenes.title: almostnode — A Server Made of Tab
scenes.summary: A full Node dev server inside one browser tab: RAM-only VirtualFS, ~75 shims, and the service-worker relay that answers /__virtual__/3000/ from the main thread.

scenes.title: almostnode — Walls & Escape Hatches
scenes.summary: Three isolation tiers (main thread, Worker, cross-origin credentialless iframe) and the only sanctioned doors out: opt-in egress via CORS proxy or WASM Tailscale, a passkey vault that never leaks, and the codex host-bridge's typed RPC.
